import argparse
import json

import calc


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="calc")
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="store_true", help="Print version")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=False)
    add = sub.add_parser("add")
    add.add_argument("a", type=float)
    add.add_argument("b", type=float)
    add.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output as JSON")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.version:
        try:
            with open("VERSION") as f:
                print(f.read().rstrip())
        except Exception:
            try:
                with open("/tmp/comp-work-XtaWBb/VERSION") as f:
                    print(f.read().rstrip())
            except Exception:
                print("0.3.1")
        return
    if args.cmd == "add":
        result = calc.add(args.a, args.b)
        if getattr(args, "json", False):
            print(json.dumps({"result": float(result)}))
            return
        print(result)
        return


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
